title: Jev at the judgement seams: semantic report checks, finding triage, BLOCKED classes, stuck disambiguation, prose acceptance
description:
After the Jev rewire (Workers AI typesafe/jev) and the report linter (4m6). Principle: deterministic rules decide everything a rule can; Jev only at judgement seams; confidence-gated (act only above a measured threshold, else do nothing / fall back to today's rule); never the sole hard refusal; every classification recorded on the run branch so a resume replays it instead of re-asking.

Seams, each tied to observed problems (2026-09-22..28):
1. Report honesty (collect, after the structural lint): status vs content (DONE while tests fail/skip), DONE_WITH_CONCERNS that is really 'gave up' (→ escalate, not merge), done-item evidence present vs merely claimed (4 epics closed without the run their acceptance names; tm5/gv0). Pushback to the same session on a confident failure.
2. Findings triage: gating prediction (#60's over-absorption; built in bse, never ran without a key), live-run/demo detection replacing #92's text match, target routing sanity (#85).
3. BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT question → standing-order class (decide-and-log vs always-ask) for tyd.
4. Stuck disambiguation (wv2): on a quiet window, classify the transcript tail (looping / waiting on something / thinking) to choose nudge vs stop.
5. Prose acceptance (6in's findings stopped for a person; #100 now backlogs them): map a finding onto the acceptance's sentences to decide gating, instead of never gating.
6. Tier start (wne): turn on with role ticks skipped and the probability-mass rule (P(design)+P(diagnosis)>0.5).
First step: measure each seam on labelled history before it is load-bearing (2jn/6in reports and findings with known outcomes; the 49-tick wne set), pick thresholds from that, record them.
acceptance_criteria: Each enabled seam has a recorded evaluation on past data with its threshold; a low-confidence answer never changes behaviour; classifications are replayed from the run branch on resume; report-honesty pushback demonstrated on a DONE-but-tests-skipped fixture
